name: Cisco Certified Network Associate

fee.note: USD list price plus tax; Pearson VUE lists the price in other countries and currencies. Cisco Learning Credits are also accepted.

exam.format: 120-minute exam (Implementing and Administering Cisco Solutions, 200-301 CCNA v1.1) through Pearson VUE, in person or online, in English or Japanese. No prerequisites. Cisco does not publish the number of questions or the passing score; the score report shows it.

scope: Network fundamentals, network access (switching, VLANs and wireless), IP connectivity and routing, IP services, security fundamentals, and network automation and programmability.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Version 1.1 can be taken until February 2, 2027; version 2.0 starts on February 3, 2027 with reorganized domains (Network Infrastructure and Connectivity 25%, Switching and Network Access 25%, IP Routing 20%, Network Services and Security 20%, AI, and Network Operations and Management 10%) and may ask candidates to evaluate output from agentic AI and digital network assistants. The domains here are v1.1's.
Recertify within three years by passing the current CCNA exam or a higher-level Cisco exam, or by earning 30 continuing education credits.

prep.title: Cisco CCNA Prep
prep.note: Cisco's free prep program: webinars, lab activities, a learning path and a practice exam. It does not say which exam version it targets.

domains_note: Weights from Cisco's CCNA Exam v1.1 (200-301) exam topics PDF, linked from the CCNA certification page, read 2026-11-17. Version 2.0 (from February 3, 2027) has different domains; see the caveats.
